title: Burn cooling and referral card
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for cooling burns early, removing tight items, covering loosely, and escalating red flags.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: face, hands, genitals, large area, deep burn, chemical burn, electrical burn, child, or breathing trouble.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: face, hands, genitals, large area, deep burn, chemical burn, electrical burn, child, or breathing trouble
